opening.argument: The speaker presents Bitcoin and Ethereum mining contracts as alternatives to bank savings, tying approximately $1,950-$2,000 to mining power and projected monthly returns of $329 or $405. The pitch directs viewers to obtain an account, complete a profile and upload KYC or agreement materials, establish related savings arrangements, and purchase a mining contract. The Ethereum offer is described as a two-year contract, while the Bitcoin comparison includes compounding proceeds into additional mining power. Although the speaker acknowledges a service fee, increasing difficulty, and an upcoming halving, those qualifications do not change the central solicitation. The quoted returns remain projections: the available evidence does not establish that either payout was received or guaranteed.
